newsitem.title: USA: President Casinos agrees to $40.5 mln buy.
newsitem.headline: President Casinos agrees to $40.5 mln buy.

text.p: President Casinos Inc said Tuesday it agreed in principal to purchase for about $40.5 million property in Biloxi, Mississippi from BH Acquisition Corp.
BH is wholly owned by John Connelly, the chairman and principal stockholder of President.
The 260-acre property includes two hotels with more than 500 rooms, a Gulf Coast marina and an 18-hole golf course.
The marina, Broadwater Marina, is currently the site of President's Biloxi casino and is leased by President from BH under a long-term lease agreement.
The acquisition is expected to be completed this month, subject to financing and other conditions.

President said it expects to invest about $5 million in a newly formed subsidiary, President Broadwater Hotel LLC, which would purchase the property. The subsidiary would pay for the purchase with $30 million of outside financing and $10 million of purchase money preferred equity from BH. The liability of the financing does not extend to President Casinos Inc, the company said.
President owns and operates riverboat and dockside gaming facilities.
